predictions.prediction_text: NVDA is expected to beat Q4 FY2026 earnings consensus but not shock the market.
predictions.expected_result: NVDA reports EPS/revenue above consensus (revenue ≈ $65.6–$66.2B or higher) but market reaction is muted (no >3% gap move up on the beat).

predictions.prediction_text: The market will focus on the composition of NVDA's revenue beat—how much comes from end-user demand versus infrastructure demand.
predictions.expected_result: If NVDA's release shows a larger proportion of infrastructure-driven revenue, NVDA stock outperforms relative to a beat driven by end-user demand; if end-user demand dominates, relative outperformance is smaller or stock underperforms on similar headline beats.
